minutes.headline: Steering committee planned public outreach for the master plan and set an extra meeting for October 19 at 6 pm.
minutes.summary: The committee discussed how to publicize the master plan: tables at Homecoming, Shrieks and Creeks and the trunk retreat, a physical town model, a separate plan website and Facebook page, and a probable public forum on November 2nd at the library. Members offered contacts and channels for spreading the word. It agreed to meet again October 19 and adjourned by roll call vote.

what_happened.line: The committee set an extra meeting for Thursday October 19 at 6 pm to go over details of the November 2nd forum and outreach materials.
Members leaned toward holding a public forum on November 2nd at the library community room, about 7 pm; the location still has to be checked for availability.
The committee built an outreach to-do list: a Parks Commission online blast, Boy Scouts and Rolling Acres contacts, condo contacts, Hickory Hills, a public access flyer, and a Ledger ad.
Members said the master plan process has no marketing budget of its own, and that the planning board could transfer money into advertising.
No votes were taken on the plan itself; the meeting adjourned by roll call.

why_it_matters: A public forum is the main stated way residents will be asked about the master plan, so the November 2nd date and place are what to hold open.
Outreach is paid for out of the planning board's budget rather than a line for the master plan, which is a mechanism that decides how widely the notice goes.
